text: このきは　なんだか　きれそうだ！

structure.jp: なんだか　きれそうだ！
structure.en: somehow looks like it can be cut!

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう stuck onto a verb or describing word means 'looks like it', judging by appearance. きれそうだ = 'it looks like it can be cut'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing きる 'cut' to きれる gives the meaning 'can cut' or 'can be cut'. きれそう = 'looks cuttable'.
